text: What are you doing here at the frontline?
You want to start a family?
What do you know about the bandits?
zh: 关于那些强盗你知道些什么？

text: We need REAL men around here, so don't do something stupid.
zh: 这里需要的是真正的爷们儿，所以别干蠢事。

text: We are dying one after another around here.
zh: 在这地方，我们正一个接一个地死去。

text: I am sort of the right hand of Renbrand.
zh: 我算是伦布兰德的左膀右臂。

text: If you ask me, it's only a matter of time until we get run over by the enemy.
zh: 要我说，我们被敌人碾平只是时间问题。

text: This place will make you forget any thoughts of starting a family.
zh: 这种地方会让你把成家的念头忘得一干二净。

text:
I think so, yeah...
But honestly? Not likely.
zh:
想过，是啊……
但说实话？没什么指望。

text: Half of the people here are dead, and the rest won't be far behind.
zh: 这里的人已经死了一半，剩下的也撑不了多久。

text: Try not to lose your head, sweetie!
zh: 小甜心，可别把脑袋弄丢了！

我？
没想什么特别的。

text:
Talk to Renbrand.
He was ordered to deal with the bandits for a short time back then.
zh:
去找伦布兰德谈谈。
当年他曾奉命对付过那些强盗一段时间。
